title: Adopt Pi 1.5 runtime and native conversation views
what: Upgrade Pi Durable, pi-ai, pi-env, pi-codemode and Chord with Agents SDK 0.33. Replace removed event and parked-task APIs with native views and idempotent continue submissions. Verify with vp run verify and local workerd HTTP/WebSocket probes. Local migration is implemented; production rollout remains pending because the original operation is still active and the stored-state upgrade is one-way.

acceptance.text: The dependency graph and checksum-pinned daemon download resolve to 1.5.0
WebSockets emit bounded native views and continue submissions are idempotent
A real Pi 1.4 SQLite conversation is preserved and continued under 1.5
The full build tests and type checks pass
Quiesce or finish active production work, retain recovery evidence, and verify the production rollout
